Hartwell J M Limited Partnership increased its stake in Federal Express (FDX) by 109.13% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hartwell J M Limited Partnership bought 19,225 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.18% with the market. The hedge fund held 36,842 shares of the air freight and delivery services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $8.85M, up from 17,617 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hartwell J M Limited Partnership who had been investing in Federal Express for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $66.57B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.56% or $3.96 during the last trading session, reaching $249.12. About 1.30M shares traded. FedEx Corporation (NYSE:FDX) has risen 29.10% since June 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 16.53% the S&P500.
